senses.gloss: m. (v. בְּרָא Ithpe. 3, cmp. בַּרְיוּתָא) rebel, outlaw, highway-man.—Pl. בַּרְיוֹנֵי, בִּי׳.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 56a:15">Gitt. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>הנהו ב׳</he> those rebels (the war party during the last siege of Jerusalem by the Romans).
<cite ref="Gittin 56a:15">Ib.</cite> Abba Sikra <he>ריש ב׳</he> chief of the rebels.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 10a:2">Ber. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>הנהו ב׳ דהוו וכ׳</he> there were some highway-men living in the neighborhood of &c.
<cite ref="Taanit 23b:7">Taan. 23ᵇ</cite> <he>א״נ הנהו בי׳ וכ׳</he> ed. (omitted in Ms. M. a. oth.).
<cite ref="Taanit 24a">Ib. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>הנך ב׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>בני מאתיה</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. l. note 2).
